headline: Clinton order changes the rules for a federal commission studying how to protect the nation's critical infrastructure.
what_it_does: This executive order amends Executive Order 13010, which set up the President's Commission on Critical Infrastructure Protection. That commission studied threats to key systems such as power, communications, and transportation. The title does not say what specific changes were made to the commission.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the President's Commission on Critical Infrastructure Protection
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules that govern how their commission is set up or how it works.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the source; executive orders usually take effect when signed (November 13, 1996).
